entries.2323d1df45f09bf0: The figures are based on revenue printed in the trend of management indicators, the percentage and amount of revenue by counterparty printed in the information by major customer in the segment information, the actual tonnage and revenue by type of cargo transported, and the business-specific status printed in management's analysis.
entries.282d7516540e8609: This is a port transportation business that mainly handles import and export cargo at the ports of Kobe, Osaka and Himeji, and also carries out customs clearance operations. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,085 million. The company has entrusted loading and unloading of goods at Himeji Port to Kabushiki Kaisha Yoshimi, an affiliated company.
entries.348a4d715f885a5a: Revenue has declined from ¥18,364 million in the fiscal year ended March 2023 to ¥14,636 million in the fiscal year ended March 2024, ¥13,726 million in March 2025 and ¥13,389 million in March 2026. By type of cargo transported, steel is the largest cargo. By major customer, the Daiwa Kogyo Co., Ltd. group accounts for 27.5% and the JFE Logistics Co., Ltd. group for 8.9%. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the coastal and ocean shipping businesses saw lower revenue due to weak steel demand and decreased transport to China and Central Asia, while the port business increased revenue on higher handling of imported food and strong export customs clearance, and the warehouse business performed steadily.
entries.368d73961accbe67: Net income for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥397 million.

entries.6927e53057022bae: This is the company's core business, with revenue from external customers of ¥7,599 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.7f5fd49d79dbcc42: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,389 million.
entries.87aac8fbbeeb36e7: Under the management philosophy 'Contributing to society through our business as a comprehensive logistics provider,' the company states it aims to become a logistics expert that anticipates customer needs and connects production and consumption. In April 2025 it formulated the long-term management vision 'VISION for 2035,' and it aims, toward fiscal 2035 as the midpoint toward its 100th anniversary, to advance to a new stage as a logistics 'solution' company, enter new business areas, and transform into a strong organization built on people. The medium-term management plan for fiscal 2025 through fiscal 2027 is positioned as three years of 'laying the foundation,' and the company states it will work on strengthening collaboration through a capital and business alliance with the Daiwa Kogyo Co., Ltd. group, expanding transport capacity by increasing vessels and crew and developing shippers, strengthening proposal-based sales through cooperation between departments, and realizing human capital management.
entries.91a9be7d89f26c8f: The company has bases at three ports, Kobe, Osaka and Himeji, and has a structure to provide, within its own group, everything from ocean transport through cargo handling and customs clearance at the ports to warehouse storage.
entries.94c731fe0dc160ea: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,389 million. By segment, the Ocean Shipping Business was ¥7,599 million and the Port and Warehousing Business was ¥5,789 million.
entries.9a34b673a7d8d258: The main cargo transported is steel products, and shippers such as steel manufacturers are the customers for coastal and ocean shipping. Port transport and warehousing handle cargo of import and export companies.
entries.9fbc9bcadf4be080: HYOKI KAIUN KAISHA,LTD. was established in 1942 through the consolidation of coastal shipping operators and shipowners in Hyogo Prefecture, and its head office is in Minatojima, Chuo-ku, Kobe. Following the completion of liquidation of a consolidated subsidiary, the company has operated on a non-consolidated basis since March 2024, and it has 236 employees (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.ac1447a0d71583ac: This is the company's core business, mainly carrying out maritime transport operations within Japan.
entries.b4c076d184afdb03: This business operates warehouses at the ports of Kobe, Osaka and Himeji, storing cargo and carrying out loading and unloading operations. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,704 million.
entries.b68169c7cd9b8301: Integrated logistics providing shipping, port transport and warehousing as one
entries.bc1319dc01fe257c: The company has bases at three ports, Kobe, Osaka and Himeji, and has a structure to provide, within its own group, everything from ocean transport through cargo handling and customs clearance at the ports to warehouse storage. Under the motto 'Safety, speed and trust,' the company states it has conducted its business as a logistics operator that fulfills its transport responsibility to customers in any era.
entries.c5ebe187e554d5cd: This business handles import and export cargo and provides warehouse storage at the ports of Kobe, Osaka and Himeji, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,789 million.

It consists of domestic coastal shipping, which carries out maritime transport within Japan, and overseas ocean shipping, which carries out overseas maritime transport using chartered vessels.
entries.ceb1d96c308dc65b: This is the company's core business, mainly carrying out maritime transport operations within Japan.
